correctness.rationale: The exact statistic is the ordinary least absent part, counted only when odd, with overlined and ordinary copies both counted for forced sizes. Terms of mex 2j+1 have factor 4^j, so j>=2 vanish mod 8 and j=1 contributes 4q^3/((1-q)(1-q^2)); the j=0 term is (1-q)/(1+q) times the inverse Jacobi theta series. Expand the inverse as 1-2Theta+4Theta^2 and apply Frobenius modulo 2 to obtain the displayed coefficient law. At n=m^2 the two 2-terms cancel and the remaining bracket m-1+floor((m^2-1)/2) is even in either parity. All non-squares have residue 2 or 6; interval-by-interval mod4 balance, with O(sqrt X) exceptional twice-squares, proves density 1/2 each. Independent coefficient DP from forced/unrestricted part sizes mod8 agreed for n=1..100, with zeros exactly the ten squares <=100. Not inferred from the finite test.
